title: Sold Twice
被賣了兩次的房間
paras: By ten o'clock, the Harbor View Hotel was at 100 percent {{occupancy|occupancy}}. A medical conference had filled every room, and Priya, the night {{receptionist|receptionist}}, had not sat down since six.
到了十點，海港景觀飯店的住房率已達百分之百。一場醫學會議住滿了每一間房，夜班櫃檯人員普莉雅從六點起就沒坐下來過。

At 11:20, a tired man in a wrinkled suit came in out of the rain. "Okafor," he said, sliding a printed {{confirmation|confirmation}} across the desk. "One king room, three nights." Priya typed his name, and her heart sank. The system had sold his room twice, and another guest had checked in an hour ago.
十一點二十分，一位穿著皺西裝的疲憊男士從雨中走了進來。「奧卡佛，」他說著，把一張列印出來的訂房確認單推過櫃檯，「一間大床房，住三晚。」普莉雅輸入他的名字，心頭一沉。系統把他的房間重複賣了出去，另一位客人一小時前已經入住了。

She had to tell him, and she watched the {{disappointment|disappointment}} settle on his face. "It's been a long day," was all he said. "Please wait in the {{lobby|lobby}}, Mr. Okafor," she told him. "Give me ten minutes." She called her manager, then came back with a key card in her hand.
她只好據實以告，並看著失望的神色浮上他的臉。他只說了一句：「今天真是漫長的一天。」「奧卡佛先生，請您先到大廳坐一下，」她說，「給我十分鐘。」她打電話給經理，然後拿著一張房卡走了回來。

"We have one suite left," she said. "I'd like to give you an {{upgrade|upgrade}} at no extra charge. Breakfast is {{complimentary|complimentary}} for all three mornings, too. I also noticed the booking site had {{overcharge|overcharged}} you for the first night, so I've fixed that."
「我們還剩一間套房，」她說，「我想幫您免費升等。三天的早餐也都免費招待。另外我發現訂房網站第一晚多收了您的錢，我已經更正了。」
For the first time, Mr. Okafor smiled. "The {{elevator|elevator}} is on your left," Priya added. "Sam will bring your bags {{upstairs|upstairs}}." "That's the best news I've had all day," he said.
奧卡佛先生這時第一次露出了笑容。「電梯在您左手邊，」普莉雅補充說，「山姆會把您的行李送上樓。」「這是我今天聽到最好的消息了，」他說。
